description: For each device class, would a person using it see or feel anything different after this change?
instructions: Judge iPhone, iPhone Duo and iPad one at a time. Would someone holding that device, in any of its positions or while moving between them, see a different screen or a different movement? A change that only applies while the Duo is half open does not change the iPhone or the iPad, even if they share the code. Device class to judge: {option}.

criteria.duo: iPhone Duo looks or moves differently in at least one position or transition
criteria.ipad: iPad looks or moves differently upright, on its side, or while turning

output: pr_visual select: recorded under jev_shadow as a hint for K.6 rule 2; a class Jev marks yes but the tree finds unchanged gets K.6 rule 3 (Checked, no change found, still no comment). Shadow: never changes the selection.
